artifact/catalog.owns: artifact metadata and logical identity catalog

artifact/content.owns: immutable content storage and content digest identity

internal_facets.owns: immutable artifact lineage edge identity

artifact/reference.owns: references, aliases and cross-system artifact pointers

data/dataset.owns: dataset identity, schema references and lifecycle

data/projection.owns: derived read models and projection lifecycle

data/query.owns: read query contracts spanning non-authoritative projections

internal_facets.owns: cross-authority read composition and query federation

environment/category.owns: environment category definitions, category/provider descriptors, compatibility and category fingerprint contracts
environment/category.must_not_own: environment instance lifecycle, provider execution, project task semantics or vendor-specific runtime state

environment/embodied.owns: embodied environment contracts, episode/trajectory interaction and provider-facing embodiment metadata
environment/embodied.must_not_own: generic environment catalog, experiment semantics, model serving, telemetry storage or vendor SDK internals

environment/instance.owns: environment instance identity, readiness and lifecycle

environment/specification.owns: environment definition and immutable spec identity

execution/policy.owns: execution admission, hierarchical capacity and fair scheduling policy
execution/policy.must_not_own: resource inventory, task execution or provider state

internal_facets.owns: priority, aging, fairness and deterministic scheduling order
internal_facets.must_not_own: live resource/admission state, quotas or executor lifecycle

execution/research_program.owns: paper-programmable ResearchProgram, RuntimeModule, rule and host authoring contracts for non-Method research Machines
execution/research_program.must_not_own: Machine Journal transition truth, MethodProgram semantics, provider effects or physical resource scheduling

execution/workflow.owns: workflow definitions, universal method-machine orchestration, and resumable control semantics

experimentation/catalog.owns: typed experiment catalog views, implementation candidates, slot health and catalog publication/query contracts
experimentation/catalog.must_not_own: experiment execution, study measurement truth, run lifecycle or benchmark implementation runtime

experimentation/evaluation.owns: evaluation contracts, execution-neutral evaluators and evaluation composition
experimentation/evaluation.must_not_own: experiment execution lifecycle or scientific claim acceptance

experimentation/experiment.owns: experiment definitions, variants and experiment lifecycle

experimentation/resource.owns: typed experiment resource policy identity, placement requirements and allocation receipts
experimentation/resource.must_not_own: physical compute truth, model-serving capacity or execution scheduling policy

experimentation/run.owns: run identity, frozen run contract and run lifecycle

experimentation/study.owns: study definitions, hypotheses and study lifecycle

experimentation/workbench.owns: typed research analysis tables, deterministic statistics/evaluation workflow and report/figure publication semantics
experimentation/workbench.must_not_own: experiment execution lifecycle, measurement truth, method semantics or vendor-specific scientific backends

experimentation/workload.owns: generic experiment task-runner contracts, workload context, task handles/results and checkpointable workload execution semantics
experimentation/workload.must_not_own: experiment definition truth, environment provider internals, participant method semantics or run durability authority

governance/algorithm.owns: repository-wide algorithm inventory, complexity baselines and regression gates
governance/algorithm.must_not_own: runtime execution or scientific result semantics

governance/concurrency.owns: repository-wide concurrency topology findings, reviewed debt baselines and concurrency regression gates
governance/concurrency.must_not_own: runtime task scheduling or mutable execution state

governance/evolution.owns: topology-driven discovery, drift detection and improvement proposals
governance/evolution.must_not_own: domain state, external effects and direct runtime mutation

governance/gate.owns: recursive gate contracts and composition semantics
governance/gate.must_not_own: business state, runtime execution or scientific acceptance

governance/performance.owns: repository-wide performance hotspots, reviewed debt baselines and performance regression gates
governance/performance.must_not_own: runtime resource scheduling or business execution

governance/quality.owns: quality gates, audits and invariants as descriptive policy

governance/repository_boundary.must_not_own: downstream project scientific or deployment policy

model/asset.owns: immutable model asset identity and provenance

internal_facets.owns: versioned model revision identity

model/deployment.owns: deployment identity, exact closure and lifecycle contract

model/qualification.owns: model/runtime/host qualification evidence and compatibility claims

model/request.owns: model request identity, exact input contract and response envelope

internal_facets.owns: model-request prompt blocks, deterministic compilation and prompt publication contracts
internal_facets.must_not_own: model serving, inference transport or participant cognition state

model/serving.owns: serving endpoint contract and request routing semantics

internal_facets.owns: serving endpoint identity and exposure contract

model/stack.owns: model stack composition and runtime build identity

internal_facets.owns: portable diagnostic snapshots assembled from existing authorities

observability/logging.owns: structured logs, context, sinks, stores, queries, retention and capture

internal_facets.owns: diagnostic context construction and propagation metadata
log query contracts and filtering
structured log schema, normalization and identity
log routing rules and fan-out decisions
sink contracts and delivery lifecycle
observation projections/indexes and read models
structured telemetry event definitions and emission contracts
metric definitions, aggregation and metric identity

operator/command.owns: operator command intent and command result contracts

participant/binding.owns: binding participants to scopes, methods, environments or models

participant/core.owns: foundational participant runtime identities, capability descriptors, runtime binding, delivery, lifecycle and checkpoint contracts
participant/core.must_not_own: project participant selection policy, method semantics, environment semantics or process supervision implementation

participant/session.owns: participant session identity and lifecycle contract

platform/concurrency.owns: process-owned bounded executors, serial lanes, timers and structured concurrency lifecycle mechanisms
platform/concurrency.must_not_own: domain mutable state, admission quotas/decisions, scheduling priority/fairness or business semantics

portfolio/project.owns: project metadata, configuration references and lifecycle

reliability/diagnostics.owns: read-side cross-system correlation and root-cause views

reliability/forensics.owns: durable evidence bundles, causal evidence and forensic indexes

reliability/recovery.owns: recovery plans, exact replay/reconcile and recovery lifecycle

internal_facets.owns: recovery execution lifecycle and effect handoff

resource/compute.owns: compute resource identity, capacities and provider facts

resource/resolution.owns: resource resolution policies and resolved bindings

runtime/host.owns: live host identity and runtime host attachment

runtime/process.owns: process identity, launch contract and lifecycle

internal_facets.owns: process health/reconcile loops

runtime/python.owns: Python interpreter environments, package lifecycle and execution bindings

runtime/server.owns: server identity, lifecycle and health contract

internal_facets.owns: server bootstrap commands, phases, durable bootstrap state/facts and forward-repair transaction contracts
internal_facets.must_not_own: persistent session implementation, release selection authority or server steady-state lifecycle policy

internal_facets.owns: runtime server health contracts
stable server identity and deployment attachment
server lifecycle state and transitions

runtime/service.owns: managed service identity, registration and lifecycle

runtime/session.owns: runtime session identity and host/process bindings

runtime/toolchain.owns: verified host toolchain acquisition, materialization, identity and receipts
runtime/toolchain.must_not_own: environment scenarios, experiment protocols, or project policy
